resources.string: Control when your phone enters Doze, with clear access checks and reversible device changes.
Any time the screen is off
No account. No ads. Device diagnostics stay on your phone.
Allow unrestricted battery use so EnforceDoze can receive screen and charging events.

Samsung / One UI: set EnforceDoze and Shizuku to Unrestricted battery use and remove them from Sleeping and Deep sleeping apps. Restart Shizuku after a reboot. If USB or wireless debugging changes disconnect Shizuku, reconnect it and return here.
Keep EnforceDoze and Shizuku allowed to run in the background. On an unrooted phone, start Shizuku again after restarting the phone.
Paused · charging or a call is active
Open EnforceDoze to resume the monitor
This settings page is unavailable on your device.
Check the current access identity, Doze state and pending restoration. These checks do not change device settings.
Tap Run checks to inspect this device.
No completed Doze sessions yet. Enable EnforceDoze and turn off the screen to begin.
Could not load the app list. Try again.
Enter a valid package name, such as com.spotify.music.
This device may deny this operation. Failures are shown in Diagnostics; reconnect access and retry any pending restoration.
Connect Shizuku or root to use this feature.
Android may defer screen-off delays and schedule boundaries to save battery. No long wake lock is held while waiting.
This package keeps essential device controls available and cannot be blocked.
Waiting for unlock · device controls restored
Keep Wi-Fi, mobile data and airplane mode unchanged while hotspot is active. If its state cannot be read, keep the connection.
Legacy ADB permission grants cannot reliably control Doze on Android 14 and later. Choose Shizuku or root for this device.
A device operation failed. Open Diagnostics for details.
Let other apps enable Doze, change automation settings and edit exemptions. Enable only when you use external automation.
Enable Allow Tasker broadcasts in Settings before using these actions. Include the EnforceDoze package in the broadcast target.
